metadata.title: Is Tide Bad for the Environment? | Tide
metadata.description: Learn how Tide evaluates environmental safety through risk-based science and why laundry detergents should be assessed using lifecycle criteria such as cold-water performance, cleaning efficacy, concentration, fabric longevity, and ingredient environmental profiles.
